name: AI SEO Masterclass - Appendix Additional Resources
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Reference lists: every tool mentioned in the course, the author's own properties, key data points and suggested learning paths.

# Tool categories listed
- **SEO research:** Ahrefs, Semrush, Keywords Everywhere, Google Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog.
- **Local and AI SEO:** LocalRank.so, Trackings.ai, IndexChex.
- **AI content:** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Koala AI, SurferSEO, Clearscope, Frase.
- **CMS:** WordPress, GeneratePress, Rank Math Pro, WP Rocket, Schema Pro, ShortPixel.
- **Outreach:** Instantly, Pitchbox, BuzzStream. **Leads:** Outscraper, LocalRank Leads.
- **Distribution:** Buffer, Medium, LinkedIn, Substack. **Automation:** Zapier, Make, n8n.
- **Proxies (for Reddit/parasite work):** BrightData, Oxylabs. **Monetization:** Amazon Associates, Mediavine, ShareASale, Impact.

# Key data points repeated
43.8% of ChatGPT citations from "Best X" listicles; 79.1% of cited content updated in the current year; the author's self-reported results.

# Learning paths suggested
- New to SEO: Modules 1, 2, 8, 9, 5.
- Experienced SEO adding AI: Modules 2, 3, 4, 8.
- Agency: Module 5, 9, case study 5, bonus B.4 and B.6.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG overlaps: Google Keyword Planner and GSC (free), [Instantly AI](lib:brain-instantly-ai) for outreach, [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) in place of most paid research tools.
- No new paid tool is adopted without Kim's approval.
